verdict.rationale: 2FAS has no dedicated sync server to self-host. Its pricing page claims 'Freedom to self-host your data', and 2FAS Pass lets you keep the vault in your own cloud or as an encrypted local file. A community report adds WebDAV as a backup target, which could point at infrastructure the admin controls. However, documented sync goes through iCloud or Google Drive, so keeping every secret inside the perimeter means relying on WebDAV or file workarounds. Missing for 10: a self-hostable sync server component, first-party docs on WebDAV or on-prem sync setup, 2FAS Auth sync options outside iCloud/Google Drive, and admin deployment guidance.
